description: Implement Supabase cloud communication and local storage management. Replace Particle cloud events with Supabase Edge Functions while maintaining compatible behavior.

publish: validate-cartridge - Send cartridge UUID for validation
reset-cartridge - Request cartridge reset on server
load-assay - Request test script by assay ID

userStories.title: Implement SupabaseClient initialization
userStories.description: Initialize HTTP client for Supabase communication.
acceptanceCriteria: Store Supabase project URL and API key
Configure HTTP client with proper headers (Authorization: Bearer, Content-Type: application/json)
Support both WiFi and Cellular connections
init() returns true on successful configuration
userStories.notes: Implemented in SupabaseClient.cpp - init(), setEndpoint(), setApiKey(), setDeviceId()

userStories.title: Implement validateCartridge() cloud call
userStories.description: Implement cartridge validation request to Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse response for validation result and assay ID
Set cartridge_state based on response (VALIDATED or INVALID)

userStories.title: Implement validation retry with exponential backoff
userStories.description: Handle validation failures with retry logic.
acceptanceCriteria: On HTTP error or timeout: increment count, schedule retry
On max retries: set cartridge_state = INVALID, transition to ERROR_STATE
Clear retry tracking on successful validation or cartridge removal
Log each retry attempt with delay
userStories.notes: Implemented in SupabaseClient.cpp - executeWithRetry() with exponential backoff

userStories.title: Implement loadAssay() cloud call
acceptanceCriteria: Parse response for assay ID, duration, BCODE string
Handle multi-part responses if BCODE exceeds payload limit
userStories.notes: Implemented in SupabaseClient.cpp - loadAssay() with checksum verification

userStories.title: Implement uploadTest() cloud call
userStories.description: Implement test result upload to Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: Request body: BrevitestTestRecord as JSON or binary
Include test metadata: cartridge_id, assay_id, start_time, duration
On failure: cache to /cache/{cartridgeId} for retry
userStories.notes: Implemented in SupabaseClient.cpp - uploadTest() with binary data and caching

userStories.title: Implement resetCartridge() cloud call
userStories.description: Implement cartridge reset request to Supabase.

userStories.title: Implement StorageManager EEPROM operations
userStories.description: Implement EEPROM read/write for persistent data.
acceptanceCriteria: Define Particle_EEPROM struct matching legacy (firmware_version, data_format_version, stress_test_cycles, running_test_uuid, running_assay_id)
setup_eeprom() reads and validates EEPROM, resets if version mismatch
reset_eeprom() clears and reinitializes with defaults
Use EEPROM.put() and EEPROM.get() for struct storage
userStories.notes: Implemented in StorageManager.cpp - loadConfig(), saveConfig(), resetConfig() with Particle_EEPROM

userStories.title: Implement StorageManager test caching
acceptanceCriteria: load_cached_test(filename) reads test record from file
test_in_cache() checks if any cached tests exist
output_cache() lists and outputs cached test data
userStories.notes: Implemented in StorageManager.cpp - cacheTestData(), loadCachedTest(), hasCachedTests(), etc.

userStories.title: Implement StorageManager assay caching
userStories.notes: Implemented in StorageManager.cpp - cacheAssay(), loadCachedAssay(), hasAssay(), listCachedAssays()

userStories.title: Implement checksum calculation
userStories.description: Implement CRC32 checksum for data validation.
userStories.notes: Implemented in StorageManager.cpp - calculateChecksum() using CRC32 lookup table matching legacy

userStories.title: Implement connection monitoring
userStories.description: Monitor cloud connection and handle reconnection.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-register subscriptions on reconnect (for Particle compatibility)
userStories.notes: Implemented in SupabaseClient.cpp - isConnected(), processConnection(), updateConnectionState()

userStories.title: Implement interrupted test recovery
userStories.description: Detect and save interrupted tests on startup.
acceptanceCriteria: Check EEPROM for running_test_uuid on startup
If test was interrupted (non-empty UUID), save to cache file
userStories.legacyReference: legacy-firmware setup() interrupted test handling lines 4834-4844
userStories.notes: Implemented in StorageManager.cpp - handleInterruptedTestRecovery() called from main.ino setup()

userStories.title: Implement magnetometer validation file management
acceptanceCriteria: load_latest_magnet_validation() finds and loads most recent
Store data in magnet_validation_data buffer (1024 bytes)
userStories.notes: Implemented in StorageManager.cpp - listValidationFiles(), clearValidationFiles(), getValidationFileCount()

userStories.title: Implement CloudProtocol data structures
userStories.description: Define all cloud protocol data structures.
acceptanceCriteria: BrevitestTestRecord struct (9668 bytes): data_format_code, cartridge_id, assay_id, start_time, duration, spectro settings, readings array
BrevitestSpectrophotometerReading struct (32 bytes): number, channel, position, temperature, laser_output, msec, f1-f8, clear, nir
BrevitestAssay struct: id, duration, BCODE_length, BCODE buffer (5000 chars)
Struct sizes must match legacy exactly for binary compatibility
userStories.notes: Implemented in DataTypes.h with static_assert verification for exact size matching (32 bytes and 9668 bytes)

userStories.title: Document cloud protocol specification
acceptanceCriteria: Document binary data format for test upload
userStories.notes: Created coordination/docs/CLOUD-PROTOCOL-SPEC.md with complete API documentation

codebasePatterns: Always check connection before cloud operations
Use request IDs for request/response correlation
Cache data locally before upload for recovery
Log all cloud operations with request details
